title: Consistent Distribution Matching for Data-Free Diffusion Distillation
title_zh: 面向无数据扩散蒸馏的一致性分布匹配

paragraphs.en: Flow and diffusion models suffer from slow inference due to computationally expensive numerical integration. Distillation provides a promising way for a student model to learn from a teacher’s dynamics, enabling one-step or few-step generation. However, existing methods often depend on curated distillation datasets, costly teacher rollouts, or auxiliary proxy networks, which complicate model training and scaling. In this work, we propose Consistent Distribution Matching, a simulation-free and data-free distillation method for accelerating diffusion and flow models while preserving strong generative capacity. Our key insight is to unify sample generation and score estimation with one student network. Thus, our framework uses only two models, a frozen teacher and a trainable student, and optimizes one objective. We prove that minimizing our objective indicates Wasserstein convergence of the student flow-map pushforwards to the teacher marginals. On ImageNet 256 × \times 256, our method attains an FID of 2.04 with a single function evaluation (1-NFE) and a 4-NFE FID of 1.37 within 40 epochs of training, surpassing the state-of-the-art distillation baselines without data. Our code code and model are available at https://consistentdmd.github.io/ .
paragraphs.zh: 流模型和扩散模型由于计算成本高昂的数值积分而存在推理缓慢的问题。 蒸馏为学生模型从教师的动态中学习提供了一种有前景的方法，从而实现单步或少步生成。 然而，现有方法通常依赖精心挑选的蒸馏数据集、耗时的教师模型运行或辅助代理网络，这使模型训练和扩展变得复杂。 在本研究中，我们提出了“一致分布匹配”（Consistent Distribution Matching），这是一种无需模拟和数据支持的蒸馏方法，可在保持强大生成能力的同时加速扩散模型和流模型。 我们的关键洞见是将样本生成与分数估计统一到一个学生网络中。 因此，我们的框架仅使用两个模型——一个冻结的教师模型和一个可训练的学生模型——并优化单一目标函数。 我们证明了，最小化我们的目标函数意味着学生模型的流映射前推分布向教师模型边缘分布的瓦瑟斯坦收敛。 在 ImageNet 256 × 256 数据集上，我们的方法仅需一次函数评估（1-NFE）即可达到 2.04 的 FID 值，并在 40 个训练周期内以 4 次函数评估（4-NFE）实现了 1.37 的 FID 值，超越了无需数据支持的当前最佳蒸馏基线方法。 我们的代码和模型可在 https://consistentdmd.github.io/ 获取。

paragraphs.en: Diffusion and flow-based generative models ( Albergo et al., 2023 ; Lipman et al., 2023 ; Liu et al., 2023 ; Dhariwal and Nichol, 2021 ; Song et al., 2021 ; Karras et al., 2022 ; Ho et al., 2020 ; Rombach et al., 2022 ; Tong et al., 2025 ) have become a leading framework for high-fidelity image and video synthesis. By learning a continuous transport from a simple prior distribution to a complex data distribution, these models provide stable training and strong sample quality across a wide spectrum of generative tasks ( Fu et al., 2025 ; Yan et al., 2023 ; Wu et al., 2023b ; Li et al., 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2025 ; Yan et al., 2025 ; Yin et al., 2025 ) . Despite these advantages, their inference cost remains non-trivial. The primary bottleneck lies in the iterative denoising procedure during inference. Generating a single sample requires numerically solving the differential equations governing the generative dynamics, which often involves hundreds of neural function evaluations.
paragraphs.zh: 扩散和流基生成模型（Albergo 等人，2023；Lipman 等人，2023；Liu 等人，2023；Dhariwal 和 Nichol，2021；Song 等人，2021；Karras 等人，2022；Ho 等人，2020；Rombach 等人，2022；Tong 等人，2025）已成为高保真图像和视频合成的主流框架。 通过从简单的先验分布到复杂的数据分布学习一种连续的迁移，这些模型在广泛的生成任务中实现了稳定的训练和高质量的样本（Fu 等人，2025；Yan 等人，2023；Wu 等人，2023b；Li 等人，2025；Zhang 等人，2025；Yan 等人，2025；Yin 等人，2025）。 尽管具有这些优势，其推理成本仍然不可忽略。 主要瓶颈在于推理过程中的迭代去噪步骤。 生成单个样本需要数值求解控制生成动态的微分方程，这通常涉及数百次神经函数评估。

sents.zh: 尽管具有这些优势，其推理成本仍然不可忽略。

sents.zh: 主要瓶颈在于推理过程中的迭代去噪步骤。

sents.en: Generating a single sample requires numerically solving the differential equations governing the generative dynamics, which often involves hundreds of neural function evaluations.
sents.zh: 生成单个样本需要数值求解控制生成动态的微分方程，这通常涉及数百次神经函数评估。

paragraphs.en: To address this challenge, diffusion distillation ( Geng et al., 2024 ; Song et al., 2023 ; Song and Dhariwal, 2023 ; Lu and Song, 2024 ; Meng et al., 2023 ; Frans et al., 2024 ; Sabour et al., 2025 ; Fu et al., 2025 ) provides a natural route to accelerate the generation with a new model. Given a powerful teacher diffuser, the student is trained to reproduce the teacher’s generative behavior while compressing the inference process in one or few steps. Existing distillation methods have made substantial progress, yet their training pipelines often introduce additional complexity. Some depend on heavy backward simulation ( Liu et al., 2023 ; Zhao et al., 2026 ; Gu et al., 2023 ) of a teacher diffusion model, auxiliary fake score networks ( Yin et al., 2024b ; Yin et al., 2024a ; Xie et al., 2024b ; Zhou et al., 2024 ; Zhou et al., 2025d ; Luo et al., 2025 ; Ge et al., 2026 ) , adversarial objectives ( Zhou et al., 2025d ; Kim et al., 2023 ; Sauer et al., 2024 ; Sauer et al., 2025 ) , or multi-stage training ( Lee et al., 2024 ) . Although these components enable high-quality generation in few steps, they incur substantial memory overhead, impose an egregiously high optimization burden, and ultimately hinder the scalability of the distillation procedure.
paragraphs.zh: 为应对这一挑战，扩散蒸馏（Geng et al., 2024；Song et al., 2023；Song and Dhariwal, 2023；Lu and Song, 2024；Meng et al., 2023；Frans et al., 2024；Sabour et al., 2025；Fu et al., 2025）为通过新模型加速生成提供了一种自然的路径。 给定一个强大的教师扩散模型，学生模型将被训练以复现教师的生成行为，同时将推理过程压缩到一步或少数几步。 现有的蒸馏方法已取得显著进展，但其训练流程往往引入了额外的复杂性。 一些方法依赖于对教师扩散模型进行复杂的反向模拟（Liu et al., 2023；Zhao et al., 2026；Gu et al., 2023）、辅助的虚假得分网络（Yin et al., 2024b；Yin et al., 2024a；Xie et al., 2024b；Zhou et al., 2024；Zhou et al., 2025d；Luo et al., 2025；Ge et al., 2026）、对抗性目标（Zhou et al., 2025d；Kim et al., 2023；Sauer et al., 2024；Sauer et al., 2025）或多阶段训练（Lee et al., 2024）。 尽管这些组件能够在少数步骤内实现高质量生成，但它们带来了巨大的内存开销、极其沉重的优化负担，并最终阻碍了蒸馏过程的扩展性。

sents.en: To address this challenge, diffusion distillation ( Geng et al., 2024 ; Song et al., 2023 ; Song and Dhariwal, 2023 ; Lu and Song, 2024 ; Meng et al., 2023 ; Frans et al., 2024 ; Sabour et al., 2025 ; Fu et al., 2025 ) provides a natural route to accelerate the generation with a new model.

sents.zh: 一些方法依赖于对教师扩散模型进行复杂的反向模拟（Liu et al., 2023；Zhao et al., 2026；Gu et al., 2023）、辅助的虚假得分网络（Yin et al., 2024b；Yin et al., 2024a；Xie et al., 2024b；Zhou et al., 2024；Zhou et al., 2025d；Luo et al., 2025；Ge et al., 2026）、对抗性目标（Zhou et al., 2025d；Kim et al., 2023；Sauer et al., 2024；Sauer et al., 2025）或多阶段训练（Lee et al., 2024）。

sents.en: Although these components enable high-quality generation in few steps, they incur substantial memory overhead, impose an egregiously high optimization burden, and ultimately hinder the scalability of the distillation procedure.
sents.zh: 尽管这些组件能够在少数步骤内实现高质量生成，但它们带来了巨大的内存开销、极其沉重的优化负担，并最终阻碍了蒸馏过程的扩展性。

paragraphs.en: Beyond this procedural complexity, reliance on external distillation data ( Yin et al., 2024b ; Yin et al., 2024a ; Peng et al., 2025 ; Song et al., 2023 ; Lu and Song, 2024 ; Meng et al., 2023 ; Zhou et al., 2024 ) introduces a fundamental source of mismatch between data and teacher probability path. Data-based methods construct intermediate states by noising real data samples, often drawn from a distillation dataset that differs from the data used to train the teacher. Consequently, these states may deviate from those actually visited by the teacher during generation, causing the student to be supervised on a surrogate state distribution, instead of along the teacher’s probability path. This mismatch of the supervision states ( Tong et al., 2025 ) becomes pronounced when fine-tuning tilts the teacher’s distribution away from the original data ( Xie et al., 2024b ; Chen et al., 2025 ; Liu et al., 2025 ) or when the teacher adopts classifier-free guidance ( Ho and Salimans, 2022 ) or autoguidance ( Karras et al., 2024 ) . In these settings, noising samples from the original data distribution provides progressively less faithful coverage of the states visited by the teacher. Moreover, when a teacher model is trained on proprietary data ( Rombach et al., 2022 ; Wu et al., 2025 ; Seedream et al., 2025 ; Labs, 2025 ) , constructing such a data-anchored supervision path may be infeasible. Direct supervision on teacher trajectories would address the mismatch, but obtaining such states requires backward simulation, thereby reintroducing the aforementioned computational burden. This trade-off motivates our central question: can we distill a diffusion or flow teacher into a few-step student without external data, teacher rollouts, or auxiliary fake score models?
paragraphs.zh: 除了这种程序上的复杂性之外，依赖外部蒸馏数据（Yin et al., 2024b；Yin et al., 2024a；Peng et al., 2025；Song et al., 2023；Lu and Song, 2024；Meng et al., 2023；Zhou et al., 2024）还会在数据与教师模型的概率路径之间引入根本性的不匹配。 基于数据的方法通过向真实数据样本添加噪声来构建中间状态，而这些样本通常来自一个与训练教师模型所用数据不同的蒸馏数据集。 因此，这些状态可能与教师模型在生成过程中实际访问的状态存在偏差，导致学生模型是基于代理状态分布进行监督的，而不是沿着教师模型的概率路径进行监督。 当微调使教师模型的分布偏离原始数据（Xie et al., 2024b；Chen et al., 2025；Liu et al., 2025），或者当教师模型采用无分类器引导（Ho and Salimans, 2022）或自动引导（Karras et al., 2024）时，这种监督状态的不匹配（Tong et al., 2025）会变得更加显著。 在这些情况下，对原始数据分布中的样本添加噪声所提供的覆盖范围，对于教师模型所访问的状态而言将变得越来越不忠实。 此外，当教师模型是在专有数据上训练的（Rombach et al., 2022；Wu et al., 2025；Seedream et al., 2025；Labs, 2025）时，构建这种以数据为锚点的监督路径可能并不可行。 对教师轨迹进行直接监督可以解决这种不匹配问题，但获取这些状态需要进行反向模拟，从而重新引入前述的计算负担。 这种权衡促使我们提出核心问题：我们是否可以在不使用外部数据、教师模型运行结果或辅助的虚假得分模型的情况下，将扩散或流模型的教师蒸馏成只需少数步骤的学生模型？

paragraphs.en: We propose Consistent Distribution Matching Distillation (CDMD), a data-free and simulation-free framework for distilling diffusion and flow models using only a frozen teacher and a trainable student. Our framework aims to circumvent the distribution mismatch issues. Our central idea is to unify sample generation and score estimation within a single flow map model, eliminating the need for a separately trained proxy network. The student predicts average velocities over arbitrary denoising time intervals, supporting generation in one or a few steps. We bootstrap intermediate training states from student predictions and analytic forward noising, avoiding real data and teacher rollouts while allowing the training distribution to evolve with the student.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了“一致分布匹配蒸馏”（Consistent Distribution Matching Distillation，CDMD）框架，这是一种无需数据和模拟的蒸馏方法，仅通过一个冻结的教师模型和一个可训练的学生模型即可蒸馏扩散模型和流模型。 我们的框架旨在规避分布不匹配的问题。 我们的核心思想是将样本生成与分数估计统一到一个流映射模型中，从而无需单独训练代理网络。 学生模型能够预测任意去噪时间区间内的平均速度，支持单步或少量步骤的生成。 我们从学生模型的预测结果和解析前向加噪过程中初始化中间训练状态，既避免了使用真实数据和教师模型的运行过程，又允许训练分布随学生模型一同演化。

sents.en: We bootstrap intermediate training states from student predictions and analytic forward noising, avoiding real data and teacher rollouts while allowing the training distribution to evolve with the student.
sents.zh: 我们从学生模型的预测结果和解析前向加噪过程中初始化中间训练状态，既避免了使用真实数据和教师模型的运行过程，又允许训练分布随学生模型一同演化。

paragraphs.en: Although these states do not necessarily coincide with those visited by the teacher during generation, our objective progressively aligns the corresponding student probability path with the teacher probability path. This enables the teacher to provide corrective velocity supervision directly on states relevant to the student’s generative dynamics. At these states, we regress the student velocity surrogate toward the teacher’s instantaneous velocity through a single objective. Moreover, as the states become noisier, they increasingly resemble the distributions encountered during teacher training, making the teacher’s velocity supervision more reliable. This trend is consistently observed across existing distribution matching baselines ( Yin et al., 2024a ; Yin et al., 2024b ) . The quality of the supervision also improves as the student distribution moves closers to the teacher distribution.
paragraphs.zh: 尽管这些状态并不一定与生成过程中教师智能体所访问的状态一致，但我们的目标会逐渐使学生的对应概率路径与教师的概率路径对齐。 这使得教师能够直接对学生生成动态相关的状态提供修正性速度监督。 在这些状态下，我们通过单一目标将学生速度代理回归到教师的瞬时速度上。 此外，随着状态变得越来越嘈杂，它们越来越接近教师训练过程中遇到的分布，从而使教师的速度监督更加可靠。 这一趋势在现有的分布匹配基线方法中（Yin et al., 2024a; Yin et al., 2024b）均被一致观察到。 随着学生分布逐渐更接近教师分布，监督的质量也会随之提升。

paragraphs.en: We further establish a theoretical connection between local transport consistency and distribution matching. Under appropriate assumptions, minimizing population loss implies that the distributions induced by the student flow map converge to the teacher marginals in squared Wasserstein-2 distance averaged over time. Importantly, this result does not require the supervision states to be sampled from the teacher’s probability path. Next, the minimizer of our objective becomes the teacher average velocity. Overall, these results explain how local consistency can identify the teacher’s transport behavior and achieve distributional alignment without auxiliary score networks.
paragraphs.zh: 我们进一步建立了局部传输一致性与分布匹配之间的理论联系。 在适当的假设下，最小化种群损失意味着由学生流图诱导的分布在时间平均的平方瓦瑟斯坦-2距离上收敛于教师边际分布。 重要的是，这一结果并不要求监督状态必须从教师的概率路径中采样。 接下来，我们目标函数的最小化器变为教师的平均速度。 总体而言，这些结果解释了局部一致性如何能够识别教师的传输行为，并在没有辅助得分网络的情况下实现分布对齐。

paragraphs.en: We introduce Consistent Distribution Matching Distillation, a data-free and simulation-free distillation framework for diffusion and flow-based generative models. The method uses only a frozen teacher and a trainable student, avoiding external distillation data, teacher rollouts and auxiliary proxy networks.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了“一致分布匹配蒸馏”（Consistent Distribution Matching Distillation），这是一种无需数据和模拟的蒸馏框架，适用于扩散模型和基于流的生成模型。 该方法仅使用一个冻结的教师模型和一个可训练的学生模型，无需外部蒸馏数据、教师模型的推理过程以及辅助代理网络。

sents.en: We introduce Consistent Distribution Matching Distillation, a data-free and simulation-free distillation framework for diffusion and flow-based generative models.
sents.zh: 我们提出了“一致分布匹配蒸馏”（Consistent Distribution Matching Distillation），这是一种无需数据和模拟的蒸馏框架，适用于扩散模型和基于流的生成模型。

sents.en: The method uses only a frozen teacher and a trainable student, avoiding external distillation data, teacher rollouts and auxiliary proxy networks.
sents.zh: 该方法仅使用一个冻结的教师模型和一个可训练的学生模型，无需外部蒸馏数据、教师模型的推理过程以及辅助代理网络。

paragraphs.en: We provide a distribution-matching analysis showing that minimizing the proposed CDMD objective leads to narrowing the gap between the teacher distribution and the student distribution under regularity assumptions. The analysis also identifies the teacher’s average velocity field as the unique global minimizer for our objective.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提供了一项分布匹配分析，结果表明，在正则性假设下，最小化所提出的 CDMD 目标函数可以缩小教师分布与学生分布之间的差距。 该分析还指出，教师的平均速度场是我们目标函数的唯一全局最小化解。

sents.en: We provide a distribution-matching analysis showing that minimizing the proposed CDMD objective leads to narrowing the gap between the teacher distribution and the student distribution under regularity assumptions.
sents.zh: 我们提供了一项分布匹配分析，结果表明，在正则性假设下，最小化所提出的 CDMD 目标函数可以缩小教师分布与学生分布之间的差距。

sents.en: The analysis also identifies the teacher’s average velocity field as the unique global minimizer for our objective.
sents.zh: 该分析还指出，教师的平均速度场是我们目标函数的唯一全局最小化解。

paragraphs.en: We analyze the variance of the JVP correction in the data-free setting and validate the analysis on synthetic datasets. These results clarify when the correction improves stability and when student-teacher path mismatch can degrade training. On ImageNet256 × \times 256, Consistent Distribution Matching Distillation achieves a 1-NFE FID of 2.04 and a 4-NFE FID of 1.37 , achieving state-of-the-art performance among data-free distillation methods. In the text-to-image comparison when training data is inaccessible, our method leads most preference and alignment metrics and FID.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在无数据设置下分析了 JVP 修正的方差，并在合成数据集上验证了这一分析。 这些结果阐明了该修正在何种情况下能提升稳定性，以及学生-教师路径不匹配又会在何时导致训练效果下降。 在 ImageNet256 × 256 数据集上，一致分布匹配蒸馏方法实现了 1-NFE FID 为 2.04、4-NFE FID 为 1.37 的性能，在无数据蒸馏方法中达到了当前最优水平。 在无法获取训练数据的文本到图像对比实验中，我们的方法在多数偏好度、对齐度指标和 FID 上均表现最佳。

sents.en: We analyze the variance of the JVP correction in the data-free setting and validate the analysis on synthetic datasets.
sents.zh: 我们在无数据设置下分析了 JVP 修正的方差，并在合成数据集上验证了这一分析。

sents.en: These results clarify when the correction improves stability and when student-teacher path mismatch can degrade training.

sents.zh: 在无法获取训练数据的文本到图像对比实验中，我们的方法在多数偏好度、对齐度指标和 FID 上均表现最佳。

paragraphs.en: This section develops Consistent Distribution Matching Distillation as a distillation method without external data or teacher simulation, as illustrated in Fig. 3 . We first motivate supervision on states bootstrapped from the student model. Beyond the tradition KL divergence, we develop Consistent Distribution Matching from a Fisher-divergence criterion using a velocity surrogate derived from the student network. Finally, we relate the resulting consistency residual to distribution matching under regularity assumptions.
paragraphs.zh: 本节提出了“一致分布匹配蒸馏”这一蒸馏方法，该方法无需外部数据或教师模型模拟，如图 3 所示。 我们首先阐述了对从学生模型中自举得到的状态进行监督的必要性。 除了传统的 KL 散度，我们还基于 Fisher 散度准则，利用从学生网络推导出的速度代理量，提出了“一致分布匹配”方法。 最后，我们在正则性假设下，将所得的一致性残差与分布匹配建立了关联。

paragraphs.en: Current distillation methods require either online training with external data or expensive offline generation of teacher samples. In the former setting, training states are drawn from a forward FM path p ~ t \tilde{p}_{t} , while the teacher follows its own probability path p t p_{t} . Since p ~ t ≠ p t \tilde{p}_{t}\neq p_{t} in general, the student is supervised on a mismatched state distribution. Training directly on p t p_{t} avoids this mismatch, but sampling intermediate teacher states requires simulating the teacher dynamics, introducing substantial computational overhead.
paragraphs.zh: 当前的蒸馏方法要么需要利用外部数据进行在线训练，要么需要耗费高昂成本地离线生成教师样本。 在前一种设定中，训练状态来自前向 FM 路径 p ~ t \tilde{p}_{t}，而教师则遵循其自身的概率路径 p t p_{t}。 由于通常情况下 p ~ t ≠ p t \tilde{p}_{t}\neq p_{t}，因此学生模型是基于一个不匹配的状态分布进行监督的。 直接在 p t p_{t} 上进行训练可以避免这种不匹配，但采样中间的教师状态需要模拟教师的动态过程，从而带来显著的计算开销。

paragraphs.en: Unifying proxy model and student generator. Motivated by SiD ( Zhou et al., 2024 ) , we therefore adopt a data-free construction based on the student rollout. However, evaluating this objective typically introduces an auxiliary model to estimate the student’s marginal velocity, which violates our design principle of involving only the teacher and student. To eliminate this extra model, the student must be capable of both generating clean samples and providing a surrogate for its own marginal velocity within a unified framework.
paragraphs.zh: 统一代理模型与学生生成器。 受 SiD（Zhou 等人，2024）的启发，我们因此采用了一种基于学生模型展开的数据无关构建方法。 然而，评估该目标通常需要引入一个辅助模型来估计学生的边际速度，这违背了我们仅涉及教师和学生模型的设计原则。 为了消除这个额外模型，学生模型必须能够在统一框架内同时生成干净样本，并提供其自身边际速度的替代表示。

paragraphs.en: This term measures the deviation of the JVP correction computed on student-generated states from the average correction on the target path. It captures both the intrinsic fluctuation of the correction under q t 𝜽 q_{t}^{{\bm{\theta}}} and the distributional mean shift between q t 𝜽 q_{t}^{{\bm{\theta}}} and p t p_{t} . Note the intrinsic JVP variance is recovered as the special case 𝒱 JVP = ℳ JVP q , q \mathcal{V}_{\mathrm{JVP}}=\mathcal{M}_{\mathrm{JVP}}^{q,q} , and the decomposition can be found in Appendix B . We evaluate these statistics for the term d 𝒙 ^ t / d t \differential\hat{{\bm{x}}}_{t}/\differential t with three viable options, i.e . d 𝒙 ^ t / d t ∈ { 𝒗 ⁡ ( 𝒙 ^ t , t ) , 𝒖 𝜽 ​ ( 𝒙 ^ t , t , t ) , 𝒖 𝜽 ​ ( 𝒛 , 1 , 0 ) } \differential\hat{{\bm{x}}}_{t}/\differential t\in\left\{{\bm{v}}(\hat{{\bm{x}}}_{t},t),\;{\bm{u}}_{\bm{\theta}}(\hat{{\bm{x}}}_{t},t,t),\;{\bm{u}}_{\bm{\theta}}({\bm{z}},1,0)\right\} . The first two terms are the teacher velocity and the student limiting velocity, while the last term is commonly known as the conditional velocity field 𝒙 1 − 𝒙 ^ 0 {\bm{x}}_{1}-\hat{{\bm{x}}}_{0} . We find that using 𝒗 ⁡ ( 𝒙 ^ t , t ) {\bm{v}}(\hat{{\bm{x}}}_{t},t) works best, shown in Fig. 5 (c) the on synthetic dataset.

sents.en: This term measures the deviation of the JVP correction computed on student-generated states from the average correction on the target path.
sents.zh: 该术语衡量学生生成的状态上计算的 JVP 修正值与目标路径上的平均修正值之间的偏差。

sents.en: It captures both the intrinsic fluctuation of the correction under q t 𝜽 q_{t}^{{\bm{\theta}}} and the distributional mean shift between q t 𝜽 q_{t}^{{\bm{\theta}}} and p t p_{t} .
sents.zh: 它既捕捉了修正值在 q t 𝜽 q_{t}^{{\bm{\theta}}} 下的内在波动，也捕捉了 q t 𝜽 q_{t}^{{\bm{\theta}}} 和 p t p_{t} 之间的分布均值偏移。

sents.en: Note the intrinsic JVP variance is recovered as the special case 𝒱 JVP = ℳ JVP q , q \mathcal{V}_{\mathrm{JVP}}=\mathcal{M}_{\mathrm{JVP}}^{q,q} , and the decomposition can be found in Appendix B .
sents.zh: 请注意，当取特殊情形 𝒱 JVP = ℳ JVP q , q \mathcal{V}_{\mathrm{JVP}}=\mathcal{M}_{\mathrm{JVP}}^{q,q} 时，可恢复出内在的 JVP 方差，其分解过程见附录 B。

sents.en: We evaluate these statistics for the term d 𝒙 ^ t / d t \differential\hat{{\bm{x}}}_{t}/\differential t with three viable options, i.e . d 𝒙 ^ t / d t ∈ { 𝒗 ⁡ ( 𝒙 ^ t , t ) , 𝒖 𝜽 ​ ( 𝒙 ^ t , t , t ) , 𝒖 𝜽 ​ ( 𝒛 , 1 , 0 ) } \differential\hat{{\bm{x}}}_{t}/\differential t\in\left\{{\bm{v}}(\hat{{\bm{x}}}_{t},t),\;{\bm{u}}_{\bm{\theta}}(\hat{{\bm{x}}}_{t},t,t),\;{\bm{u}}_{\bm{\theta}}({\bm{z}},1,0)\right\} .
sents.zh: 我们对术语 d 𝒙 ^ t / d t \differential\hat{{\bm{x}}}_{t}/\differential t 的这三个可行选项进行了统计评估，即 d 𝒙 ^ t / d t ∈ { 𝒗 ⁡ ( 𝒙 ^ t , t ) , 𝒖 𝜽 ​ ( 𝒙 ^ t , t , t ) , 𝒖 𝜽 ​ ( 𝒛 , 1 , 0 ) } \differential\hat{{\bm{x}}}_{t}/\differential t\in\left\{{\bm{v}}(\hat{{\bm{x}}}_{t},t),\;{\bm{u}}_{\bm{\theta}}(\hat{{\bm{x}}}_{t},t,t),\;{\bm{u}}_{\bm{\theta}}({\bm{z}},1,0)\right\}。

sents.en: The first two terms are the teacher velocity and the student limiting velocity, while the last term is commonly known as the conditional velocity field 𝒙 1 − 𝒙 ^ 0 {\bm{x}}_{1}-\hat{{\bm{x}}}_{0} .
sents.zh: 前两项分别是教师速度和学生的极限速度，而最后一项通常被称为条件速度场 𝒙 1 − 𝒙 ^ 0 {\bm{x}}_{1}-\hat{{\bm{x}}}_{0}。

sents.en: We find that using 𝒗 ⁡ ( 𝒙 ^ t , t ) {\bm{v}}(\hat{{\bm{x}}}_{t},t) works best, shown in Fig. 5 (c) the on synthetic dataset.
sents.zh: 我们发现使用 𝒗 ⁡ ( 𝒙 ^ t , t ) {\bm{v}}(\hat{{\bm{x}}}_{t},t) 的效果最佳，如图 5(c) 所示（数据来自合成数据集）。

paragraphs.en: Below we test CDMD on a synthetic 2D benchmark, class-conditional ImageNet 256 × \times 256, and text-to-image generation with SANA-1.6B. We then ablate guidance, the training-state distribution, and the number of sampling steps.
paragraphs.zh: 下面，我们在一个合成的二维基准数据集、按类别条件化的 ImageNet 256 × \times 256 数据集，以及使用 SANA-1.6B 进行的文本到图像生成任务上测试 CDMD。 接着，我们对引导机制、训练状态分布以及采样步数进行消融分析。

sents.en: Below we test CDMD on a synthetic 2D benchmark, class-conditional ImageNet 256 × \times 256, and text-to-image generation with SANA-1.6B.
sents.zh: 下面，我们在一个合成的二维基准数据集、按类别条件化的 ImageNet 256 × \times 256 数据集，以及使用 SANA-1.6B 进行的文本到图像生成任务上测试 CDMD。

sents.en: We then ablate guidance, the training-state distribution, and the number of sampling steps.
sents.zh: 接着，我们对引导机制、训练状态分布以及采样步数进行消融分析。

paragraphs.en: Setup. On ImageNet 256 × \times 256, we distill three teachers: SiT-XL/2 ( Ma et al., 2024 ) , SiT-XL/2 trained with VA-REPA ( Yang et al., 2026 ) , and LightningDiT-XL/2 with a VA-VAE autoencoder ( Yao et al., 2025 ) . The student uses the teacher architecture, with extra embeddings for r r and w w (Appendix D ). We report FID-50K and IS. All baselines use the same training budget and the same evaluation pipeline. For text-to-image, we follow the protocol of MFD ( Zhao et al., 2026 ) with a SANA-1.6B teacher ( Xie et al., 2024a ) . Full hyperparameters are listed in Tab. 5 .
paragraphs.zh: 设置。 在 ImageNet 256 × \times 256 数据集上，我们蒸馏了三个教师模型：SiT-XL/2（Ma et al., 2024）、使用 VA-REPA 训练的 SiT-XL/2（Yang et al., 2026），以及配备 VA-VAE 自编码器的 LightningDiT-XL/2（Yao et al., 2025）。 学生模型采用教师模型的结构，并为 r 和 w 添加了额外的嵌入层（附录 D）。 我们报告了 FID-50K 和 IS 指标。 所有基线模型均使用相同的训练预算和相同的评估流程。 对于文本到图像生成任务，我们遵循 MFD（Zhao et al., 2026）的方案，并使用 SANA-1.6B 教师模型（Xie et al., 2024a）。 完整的超参数列表见表 5。

paragraphs.en: Synthetic benchmark. We first use a 2D spiral, where both the target distribution and the ground-truth average velocity are known. The exact velocity field serves as the teacher. This removes the effect of a learned teacher checkpoint and of image metrics. We track two quantities during training (Fig. 5 ). First, CDMD and FreeFlow reduce the endpoint W 2 W_{2} distance at the same rate. Endpoint matching therefore cannot distinguish the two methods. Second, only CDMD keeps reducing the teacher average-velocity MSE, while FreeFlow plateaus at a much higher value. This suggests that matching the endpoint marginal does not imply learning the teacher transport map . The full metrics in Tab. 6 show the same pattern. Marginal Wasserstein scores are tied, but CDMD has lower coupled endpoint error and lower teacher average-velocity error. Appendix D provides the full setup. In Fig. 5 (c), we observe that JVP yields the most stable behavior when computed in the teacher direction, even on student-bootstrapped states.
paragraphs.zh: 合成基准测试。 我们首先使用一个二维螺旋结构，其中目标分布和真实平均速度均为已知。 精确的速度场充当教师智能体。 这消除了已学习教师检查点和图像指标的影响。 我们在训练过程中跟踪两个量（图 5）。 首先，CDMD 和 FreeFlow 以相同的速度减小终点的 W₂ 距离。 因此，终点匹配无法区分这两种方法。 其次，只有 CDMD 持续减小教师平均速度的均方误差，而 FreeFlow 则在一个高得多的值处趋于平稳。 这表明匹配终点边缘分布并不意味着学会了教师的传输映射。 表 6 中的完整指标显示了相同的模式。 边缘 Wasserstein 分数相同，但 CDMD 的耦合终点误差和教师平均速度误差更低。 附录 D 提供了完整的设置细节。 在图 5(c) 中，我们观察到，当沿教师方向计算时，JVP 表现出最稳定的行为，即使在学生自启动状态下也是如此。

paragraphs.en: ImageNet 256 × \times 256. Tab. 1 groups data-free methods by teacher under matched training budgets. CDMD achieves the best 1-NFE FID across all three teachers: 3.47 with SiT-XL/2, 2.93 with SiT-XL/2+VA-REPA, and 2.04 with LightningDiT-XL/2. It also benefits more from stronger teachers: replacing SiT-XL/2 with VA-REPA improves CDMD by 0.54 FID, compared with 0.41 for FreeFlow and 0.07 for DMD2, while MeanFlow degrades. Without retraining, the same student further improves with additional NFEs, reaching FIDs of 2.60 with VA-REPA and 1.62 with LightningDiT-XL/2 at 2 NFEs, and 1.37 at 4 NFEs, close to the teacher’s 1.35. We omit FreeFlow without DMD in the LightningDiT block because it fails to converge within the training budget. Baselines marked with ⋆ \star are one-step methods that we adapt to the data-free setting. Specifically, we construct training states by noising clean samples from the current student generator, corresponding to the s = 0 s=0 case of CDMD. Notice that, these adaptations remain worse comparing to CDMD.
paragraphs.zh: ImageNet 256 × \times 256。 表 1 按匹配的训练预算将无数据方法按教师模型进行分组。 CDMD 在所有三种教师模型中均实现了最佳的 1-NFE FID：使用 SiT-XL/2 时为 3.47，使用 SiT-XL/2+VA-REPA 时为 2.93，使用 LightningDiT-XL/2 时为 2.04。 它也从更强的教师模型中获益更多：将 SiT-XL/2 替换为 VA-REPA 可使 CDMD 的 FID 提升 0.54，而 FreeFlow 的提升为 0.41，DMD2 的提升为 0.07，同时 MeanFlow 的性能则下降。 无需重新训练，相同的学生在增加 NFE 后性能进一步提升：在 2 NFE 时，使用 VA-REPA 的 FID 达到 2.60，使用 LightningDiT-XL/2 时达到 1.62；在 4 NFE 时达到 1.37，接近教师模型的 1.35。 由于 FreeFlow（不含 DMD）在 LightningDiT 模块中无法在训练预算内收敛，因此我们未将其列出。 标有 ⋆ \star 的基线方法为一步法，我们已将其适配到无数据设置中。 具体而言，我们通过为当前学生生成器的干净样本添加噪声来构建训练状态，这对应于 CDMD 中的 s = 0 s=0 情况。 请注意，这些适配方法与 CDMD 相比仍然表现更差。

sents.en: CDMD achieves the best 1-NFE FID across all three teachers: 3.47 with SiT-XL/2, 2.93 with SiT-XL/2+VA-REPA, and 2.04 with LightningDiT-XL/2.

sents.en: It also benefits more from stronger teachers: replacing SiT-XL/2 with VA-REPA improves CDMD by 0.54 FID, compared with 0.41 for FreeFlow and 0.07 for DMD2, while MeanFlow degrades.
sents.zh: 它也从更强的教师模型中获益更多：将 SiT-XL/2 替换为 VA-REPA 可使 CDMD 的 FID 提升 0.54，而 FreeFlow 的提升为 0.41，DMD2 的提升为 0.07，同时 MeanFlow 的性能则下降。

sents.zh: 请注意，这些适配方法与 CDMD 相比仍然表现更差。

paragraphs.en: Inference-time scaling. FreeFlow ( Tong et al., 2025 ) is anchored to the prior. Its student only takes noise at t = 1 t=1 , so it cannot be applied over sub-intervals. In contrast, CDMD learns 𝒖 𝜽 ​ ( 𝒙 t , t , r ) {\bm{u}}_{\bm{\theta}}({\bm{x}}_{t},t,r) for any interval, so extra steps are available at inference time. Fig. 6 (a) shows that the benefit depends on guidance. With w = 1.5 w=1.5 , FID keeps improving with more steps and approaches the dashed reference. With w = 2.0 w=2.0 , FID is best at very few steps and worsens as steps increase. This suggests that strong guidance helps one-step generation but amplifies the student–teacher mismatch over multi-step sampling. Fig. 11 in the appendix shows that the gain from extra steps also depends on the sampler.
paragraphs.zh: 推理时的扩展。 FreeFlow（Tong 等人，2025）以先验知识为基础。 其学生模型仅在 t = 1 时引入噪声，因此无法应用于子区间。 相比之下，CDMD 能为任何区间学习 𝒖 𝜽 ​ ( 𝒙 t , t , r ) {\bm{u}}_{\bm{\theta}}({\bm{x}}_{t},t,r)，因此在推理时可获得额外步数。 图 6(a) 显示，其效果取决于引导强度。 当 w = 1.5 时，随着步数增加，FID 持续改善，并接近虚线参考值。 当 w = 2.0 时，FID 在步数极少的情况下表现最佳，而随着步数增加，效果变差。 这表明，强引导有助于单步生成，但在多步采样中会放大学生模型与教师模型之间的不匹配。 附录中的图 11 显示，额外步数带来的增益也取决于采样器。

paragraphs.en: Text-to-image generation. We distill SANA-1.6B ( Xie et al., 2024a ) , a flow-matching text-to-image model. The teacher and student are initialized from the same checkpoint. We follow the protocol of MFD ( Zhao et al., 2026 ) , training and evaluating on LAION-Aesthetics 6.5+ ( Schuhmann et al., 2022 ) . paragraphs.en: Tab. 3 gives three findings. First, among learned 4-NFE methods, CDMD has the best Aesthetic Score, PickScore (PS), and ImageReward (IR). Its FID of 27.83 is also below MFD’s 28.77. Second, CDMD beats the teacher run at 4 NFEs on all six metrics, and it beats the 20-NFE teacher on Aesthetic Score, IR, and FID. Third, CDMD trails on HPSv2 and CLIPScore, where four and five of the six baselines score higher, respectively. These results show that CDMD works in one large-scale text-to-image setting. They do not establish statistical superiority. CDMD is also cheap to train. It uses about 7 GPU hours, compared with 22 for Diff-Instruct, 25 for MFD, and 30 for DMD2 (Tab. 7 ). Only consistency distillation is cheaper ( ∼ \sim 4 GPU hours), yet it scores lower on all five point metrics. All costs are measured on one NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 GPU, the same setup as the baseline measurements of MFD ( Zhao et al., 2026 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 表3列出了三项研究结果。 首先，在已学习的4-NFE方法中，CDMD在美学得分（Aesthetic Score）、PickScore（PS）和ImageReward（IR）方面表现最佳。 其FID值为27.83，也低于MFD的28.77。 其次，在4 NFEs条件下，CDMD在全部六个指标上均优于教师模型运行结果，并且在美学得分、IR和FID方面也优于20-NFE的教师模型。 第三，CDMD在HPSv2和CLIPScore方面表现稍逊，其中六个基线模型中分别有四个和五个模型得分更高。 这些结果表明，CDMD在一个大规模文本到图像生成设置中是有效的。 但这些结果并未证明其具有统计上的显著优势。 CDMD的训练成本也较低。 它大约需要7个GPU小时，而Diff-Instruct需要22个，MFD需要25个，DMD2则需要30个（表7）。 只有一致性蒸馏的成本更低（约4 GPU小时），但它在所有五个点状指标上的得分都较低。 所有成本均基于同一台NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 GPU进行测量，这与MFD的基线测量设置相同（Zhao et al., 2026）。

paragraphs.en: Trajectory Distillation. Distillation accelerates diffusion sampling by training students to reproduce the teacher’s dynamics in fewer steps. Knowledge distillation ( Zheng et al., 2023 ) learns a direct mapping from noise to data, while progressive distillation ( Salimans and Ho, 2022 ; Meng et al., 2023 ) repeatedly halves the number of sampling steps. Consistency models ( Lu and Song, 2024 ; Song and Dhariwal, 2023 ; Song et al., 2023 ; Luo et al., 2023a ) map states along the same ODE trajectory to a shared clean sample. Flow map distillation ( Boffi et al., 2025 ; Geng et al., 2025a ; Geng et al., 2025b ; Sabour et al., 2025 ; Lee et al., 2026 ) extends this idea to transitions between arbitrary times along a trajectory. BOOT ( Gu et al., 2023 ) , π \pi -Flow ( Chen et al., 2025 ) , and rectified flow ( Liu et al., 2023 ) explore ways to reduce reliance on real training data. For methods that require teacher reference trajectories, generating them during training or precomputing them can limit scalability as tasks become more complex. Our method avoids numerically integrating the teacher during training. Compared with FreeFlow ( Tong et al., 2025 ) , which anchors its flow map at noise, our model supports transitions from arbitrary input states and times.
paragraphs.zh: 轨迹蒸馏。 蒸馏通过训练学生智能体在更少的步骤中复现教师智能体的动态，从而加速扩散采样。 知识蒸馏（Zheng 等，2023）学习从噪声到数据的直接映射，而渐进式蒸馏（Salimans 和 Ho，2022；Meng 等，2023）则重复减半采样步骤的数量。 一致性模型（Lu 和 Song，2024；Song 和 Dhariwal，2023；Song 等，2023；Luo 等，2023a）将沿同一常微分方程轨迹的状态映射到一个共享的干净样本。 流图蒸馏（Boffi 等，2025；Geng 等，2025a；Geng 等，2025b；Sabour 等，2025；Lee 等，2026）将这一思想扩展到轨迹上任意时间点之间的转换。 BOOT（Gu 等，2023）、π \pi -Flow（Chen 等，2025）和修正流（Liu 等，2023）探索了减少对真实训练数据依赖的方法。 对于需要教师参考轨迹的方法而言，在训练期间生成这些轨迹或预先计算它们可能会随着任务复杂性的增加而限制可扩展性。 我们的方法避免了在训练期间对教师智能体进行数值积分。 与将流图锚定在噪声处的 FreeFlow（Tong 等，2025）相比，我们的模型支持从任意输入状态和时间点开始的转换。

paragraphs.en: We presented CDMD, a data-free and simulation-free framework for distilling pretrained diffusion and flow-based teachers into efficient one-step or few-step flow map students. Our method eliminates the need for external distillation data, teacher rollouts, backward simulation, and auxiliary proxy networks by training on a student-induced distribution with a single objective. Motivated by the velocity form Theoretically, we showed that, under regularity assumptions, minimizing our CDMD objective leads to convergence of student sampling distributions to teacher distributions in Wasserstein distance, averaged over reference times, and every global minimizer recovers the teacher average velocity on sampled states. Empirically, CDMD achieves state-of-the-art ImageNet256 × \times 256 generation quality among data-free distillation methods and further benefits from inference-time scaling through its parameterization. Our method also achieves the best overall performance in text-to-image generation, leading on both preference and alignment metrics as well as image-quality metrics. These results suggest that strong data-free distillation can be achieved with a simpler two-model training pipeline, while preserving the flexibility of multi-step sampling. Future work includes improving the stability of the JVP term, developing initialization strategies when no model weights are available, and extending the framework to large-scale generative tasks where data scarcity problem dominates.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了 CDMD，这是一种无需数据和模拟的框架，可将预训练的扩散模型和流模型教师智能体蒸馏为高效的单步或少步流映射学生智能体。 我们的方法通过仅使用学生智能体诱导的分布进行训练，并采用单一目标函数，从而无需外部蒸馏数据、教师智能体的推理过程、反向模拟以及辅助代理网络。 受速度形式的启发，我们从理论上证明，在满足正则性假设的条件下，最小化我们的 CDMD 目标函数可使学生采样分布在 Wasserstein 距离上收敛于教师智能体的分布（该距离在参考时间上取平均），并且每个全局最小解都能恢复出采样状态上的教师智能体平均速度。 从实验结果来看，CDMD 在无需数据的蒸馏方法中实现了当前最先进的 ImageNet256 × 256 图像生成质量，并通过其参数化设计进一步受益于推理时的扩展性。 我们的方法在文本到图像生成任务中也取得了最佳的整体性能，在偏好度、对齐度以及图像质量的各项指标中均表现领先。 这些结果表明，通过更简单的双模型训练流程，即可实现强大的无数据蒸馏，同时保留多步采样的灵活性。 未来的工作包括提升 JVP 项的稳定性，在无法获取模型权重时开发初始化策略，以及将该框架扩展到大规模生成任务中，以应对数据稀缺问题更为突出的情况。

paragraphs.en: Tab. 4 compares representative distillation methods by the number of networks and optimizers they need, and by whether they require real data, trajectory simulation, or an adversarial objective. DMD2, SiD-LSG, SiDA, FreeFlow, and CTM train a third auxiliary network, either a fake-score model or a discriminator, with a second optimizer. paragraphs.en: In practice, 𝒗 N {\bm{v}}_{\text{N}} is estimated by an auxiliary proxy FM model trained on student-generated samples, using either fine-tuning or LoRA adaptation. FreeFlow thus combines a trajectory-consistency prediction term with a distribution-level correction term, while requiring only prior samples from p 1 p_{1} . This prior-anchored formulation introduces a trade-off: it simplifies distillation by avoiding supervision over arbitrary timestep pairs, but confines training to trajectories initialized at t = 1 t=1 . As a result, the student is optimized primarily as a one-step noise-to-data sampler, rather than as a general flow map capable of modeling denoising transitions between arbitrary timesteps ( t , r ) (t,r) with t > r t>r . Consequently, it reduces training complexity at the cost of limiting inference-time scaling and not naturally preserving the multi-step scaling behavior of the original flow model.
paragraphs.zh: 在实践中，𝒗 N {\bm{v}}_{\text{N}} 是通过一个在学生模型生成的样本上训练的辅助代理 FM 模型进行估计的，该模型采用微调或 LoRA 自适应方法。 因此，FreeFlow 将轨迹一致性预测项与分布级修正项相结合，同时仅需来自 p 1 p_{1} 的先验样本。 这种以先验为锚点的公式引入了一个权衡：它通过避免对任意时间步对进行监督来简化蒸馏过程，但将训练限制在从 t = 1 t=1 初始化的轨迹上。 因此，学生模型主要被优化为一种单步噪声到数据的采样器，而非一种能够模拟任意时间步 ( t , r ) (t,r)（其中 t > r t>r）之间去噪转换的通用流映射。 因此，这种方法降低了训练复杂度，但代价是限制了推理时的扩展能力，并且无法自然地保留原始流模型的多步扩展行为。

paragraphs.en: In the notation of FreeFlow ( Tong et al., 2025 ) , 𝑭 𝜽 {\bm{F}}_{{\bm{\theta}}} denotes the forward-time velocity, whereas our 𝒖 ⁡ ( ⋅ ) {\bm{u}}(\cdot) denotes the corresponding backward-time velocity. Therefore, the two are related by 𝑭 𝜽 = − 𝒖 ⁡ ( ⋅ ) {\bm{F}}_{{\bm{\theta}}}=-{\bm{u}}(\cdot) . Beyond this notational difference, FreeFlow relies on pseudo-gradients propagated through student-generated trajectories, typically over intervals such as [ 0 , 1 ] [0,1] or [ t , 1 ] [t,1] . Consequently, its updates depend on the quality of the intermediate student states 𝒙 ^ t \hat{{\bm{x}}}_{t} , which may introduce additional sensitivity during training. In contrast, our method avoids this rollout dependence by providing supervision directly on arbitrary local intervals [ r , t ] [r,t] . This enables training across the denoising process without explicitly simulating intermediate student trajectories.

paragraphs.en: The backbone architectures follow SiT, which is based on DiT ( Peebles and Xie, 2023 ) with adaLN-Zero ( Peebles and Xie, 2023 ) for conditioning. To condition the student model on the additional variables, we use a two-layer SiLU-activated MLP whose hidden dimension matches the model’s hidden dimension. We add new embeddings for r r and w w , and adopt adaLN-Zero for conditioning. The resulting conditioning signal is fed to each transformer block. No further architectural changes are necessary for stable and effective training. Note that SiT teacher and SiT+VA-REPA have different configurations on what the time in FM represents. SiT adopts the convention when 𝒙 1 ∼ p data , 𝒙 0 ∼ p prior {\bm{x}}_{1}\sim p_{\text{data}},{\bm{x}}_{0}\sim p_{\text{prior}} which is the opposite of the notion we adopt in this paper. Our convention on FM time aligns with SiT+VA-REPA ( Yang et al., 2026 ) or SiT+REPA ( Yu et al., 2024 ) in their implementation. Our training algorithm strictly follows 1 . In addition, we use Flash-Attention to reduce GPU memory usage and accelerate training. Plus, we customize the Flash-Attention kernel to support JVP computation, following sCM ( Lu and Song, 2024 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 骨干架构遵循 SiT，其基于 DiT（Peebles 和 Xie，2023），并使用 adaLN-Zero（Peebles 和 Xie，2023）进行条件约束。 为了将学生模型与额外变量进行条件关联，我们使用一个带有 SiLU 激活函数的双层 MLP，其隐藏维度与模型的隐藏维度相匹配。 我们为 r 和 w 添加了新的嵌入向量，并采用 adaLN-Zero 进行条件约束。 由此产生的条件信号被输入到每个 Transformer 块中。 无需进一步修改架构即可实现稳定且有效的训练。 请注意，SiT 教师模型与 SiT+VA-REPA 在 FM 中的时间所代表含义上具有不同的配置。 SiT 沿用了当 𝒙₁ ∼ p_data、𝒙₀ ∼ p_prior 时的惯例，这与本文采用的概念相反。 我们对 FM 时间的定义与 SiT+VA-REPA（Yang 等，2026）或 SiT+REPA（Yu 等，2024）在其实现中的做法一致。 我们的训练算法严格遵循第 1 条。 此外，我们使用 Flash-Attention 来减少 GPU 内存占用并加速训练。 同时，我们根据 sCM（Lu 和 Song，2024）的做法，对 Flash-Attention 内核进行了定制以支持 JVP 计算。

paragraphs.en: Inspired by DMF ( Lee et al., 2026 ) , we investigate delaying endpoint conditioning to the later DiT blocks, as illustrated in Fig. 13 . It is important to note that our architecture also differs from DMF ( Lee et al., 2026 ) : rather than decoupling the t t and r r signals, we preserve the original time-conditioning branch throughout the network and inject the additional endpoint signal only into the later DiT blocks. We find this design to be more effective for data-free distillation. Empirically, we find that decoupling strategy from DMF can accelerate FID convergence during early training, but does not improve the final performance and can occasionally degrade it. We thereby ablate both the form of the conditioning signal and the layer at which endpoint-related information is introduced in the data-free setting. Our results show that conditioning on the interval t − r t-r , as in MeanFlow, consistently performs best. Moreover, for our 28-block student, injecting this signal from an intermediate block performs much better than injecting it in every block, with the best FID at block 8 8 under a 25K-iteration budget (Tab. 8 ); our full LightningDiT-XL/2 run uses block 10 10 (Tab. 5 ). Appendix E discusses this ablation in detail. Importantly, the original timestep t t remains available to all DiT blocks, while the additional t − r t-r conditioning is introduced only from block 10 10 onward. This design therefore differs from DMF: rather than fully decoupling the timestep and endpoint signals, we retain global conditioning on t t and selectively inject the interval signal into later layers.
paragraphs.zh: 受 DMF（Lee 等人，2026）的启发，我们研究了将端点条件化延迟到较晚的 DiT 模块中的方法，如图 13 所示。 需要指出的是，我们的架构也与 DMF（Lee 等人，2026）有所不同：我们没有将 t t 和 r r 信号解耦，而是在整个网络中保留了原始的时间条件化分支，并且仅在较晚的 DiT 模块中注入额外的端点信号。 我们发现这种设计在数据蒸馏方面更为有效。 从经验上看，我们发现 DMF 中的解耦策略可以在训练初期加速 FID 的收敛，但并未提升最终性能，有时甚至会导致性能下降。 因此，我们在无数据设置中同时对条件化信号的形式以及引入端点相关信息的层进行了消融分析。 我们的结果表明，像 MeanFlow 那样基于区间 t − r t-r 进行条件化始终表现最佳。 此外，对于我们的 28 模块学生模型，从中间模块注入该信号的效果远优于在每个模块中注入，在 25K 次迭代的预算下，第 8 8 模块的 FID 最佳（表 8）；而我们完整的 LightningDiT-XL/2 运行则使用了第 10 10 模块（表 5）。 附录 E 详细讨论了这项消融分析。 重要的是，原始时间步 t t 仍然对所有 DiT 模块可用，而额外的 t − r t-r 条件化仅从第 10 10 模块开始引入。 因此，这种设计与 DMF 有所不同：我们没有完全解耦时间步和端点信号，而是保留了 t t 的全局条件化，并选择性地将在区间信号注入到较晚的层中。

sents.zh: 附录 E 详细讨论了这项消融分析。

sents.en: Importantly, the original timestep t t remains available to all DiT blocks, while the additional t − r t-r conditioning is introduced only from block 10 10 onward.
sents.zh: 重要的是，原始时间步 t t 仍然对所有 DiT 模块可用，而额外的 t − r t-r 条件化仅从第 10 10 模块开始引入。

sents.en: This design therefore differs from DMF: rather than fully decoupling the timestep and endpoint signals, we retain global conditioning on t t and selectively inject the interval signal into later layers.
sents.zh: 因此，这种设计与 DMF 有所不同：我们没有完全解耦时间步和端点信号，而是保留了 t t 的全局条件化，并选择性地将在区间信号注入到较晚的层中。

Across both datasets, evaluating the JVP along the teacher tangent, d 𝒙 ^ t / d t = 𝒗 ⁡ ( 𝒙 ^ t , t ) \differential\hat{{\bm{x}}}_{t}/\differential t={\bm{v}}(\hat{{\bm{x}}}_{t},t) , consistently yields the smallest and most stable correction statistics throughout training. The local student tangent, 𝒖 𝜽 ​ ( 𝒙 ^ t , t , t ) {\bm{u}}_{\bm{\theta}}(\hat{{\bm{x}}}_{t},t,t) , results in a modest increase in both quantities, whereas the global one-step student displacement, 𝒖 𝜽 ​ ( 𝒛 , 1 , 0 ) {\bm{u}}_{\bm{\theta}}({\bm{z}},1,0) , exhibits substantially larger variability and an increasing trend over training. paragraphs.en: To adapt our method on text-to-image dataset at a larger scale, some aspects need to be altered. First, we need to anchor on the teacher trajectory to prevent drifting effect. Similar to the baselines, we use 4 step during our inference. To control the noise added during training, we adopt the TDM ( Luo et al., 2025 ) method in our data-free setting. Every time we construct the intermediate states we start with the nearest earlier teacher checkpoint and we add noise according to the forward path. We decrease the variance of our target which leads to a better final performance. Fig. 10 illustrates this construction. The student generator first moves the prior sample backward along a coarse schedule, 𝒙 1 → 𝒙 ^ s → 𝒙 ^ r → 𝒙 ^ 0 {\bm{x}}_{1}\to\hat{{\bm{x}}}_{s}\to\hat{{\bm{x}}}_{r}\to\hat{{\bm{x}}}_{0} , and caches every intermediate state. A training state at time t t is then obtained by re-noising the nearest cached state that is cleaner than t t along the forward conditional path: 𝒙 ^ 0 \hat{{\bm{x}}}_{0} for t ∈ [ 0 , r ) t\in[0,r) , 𝒙 ^ r \hat{{\bm{x}}}_{r} for t ∈ [ r , s ) t\in[r,s) , and 𝒙 ^ s \hat{{\bm{x}}}_{s} for t ∈ [ s , 1 ] t\in[s,1] . Each re-noising step therefore covers a short interval, so the training states stay close to the 4-step trajectory used at inference. In this case, we observe more diversed background and better detailed being preserved from the teacher model. With the same hardware and matching configuration, our CDMD requires approximately 7 GPU hours and 18 GB of peak memory (Tab. 7 ) . Its cost is higher than CD but lower than the reported costs of Diff-Instruct, DMD2, and MFD. Note that our method performs significantly better than CD according to Table 3 .
paragraphs.zh: 为了在更大规模上将我们的方法应用于文本到图像数据集，某些方面需要调整。 首先，我们需要锚定在教师轨迹上，以防止漂移效应。 与基线方法类似，我们在推理过程中使用 4 个步骤。 为了控制训练过程中添加的噪声，我们在无数据设置中采用了 TDM（Luo 等人，2025）方法。 每次构建中间状态时，我们都从最近的早期教师检查点开始，并根据前向路径添加噪声。 我们降低了目标方差，从而获得了更好的最终性能。 图 10 展示了这种构建过程。 学生生成器首先沿着粗略的时间安排将先验样本向后移动：𝒙₁ → 𝒙^s → 𝒙^r → 𝒙^0 {\bm{x}}_{1}\to\hat{{\bm{x}}}_{s}\to\hat{{\bm{x}}}_{r}\to\hat{{\bm{x}}}_{0}，并缓存每个中间状态。 随后，通过在沿前向条件路径上比时间 t 更干净的最近缓存状态重新添加噪声，可以获得时间 t 的训练状态：对于 t ∈ [0, r)，使用 𝒙^0 \hat{{\bm{x}}}_{0}；对于 t ∈ [r, s)，使用 𝒙^r \hat{{\bm{x}}}_{r}；对于 t ∈ [s, 1]，使用 𝒙^s \hat{{\bm{x}}}_{s}。 因此，每次重新添加噪声的步骤都覆盖一个短区间，使得训练状态保持接近推理时使用的 4 步轨迹。 在这种情况下，我们观察到背景更加多样化，并且从教师模型中保留了更丰富的细节。 在相同的硬件和匹配配置下，我们的 CDMD 需要大约 7 GPU 小时和 18 GB 的峰值内存（表 7）。 其成本高于 CD，但低于 Diff-Instruct、DMD2 和 MFD 报告的成本。 请注意，根据表 3，我们的方法在性能上显著优于 CD。

sents.zh: 学生生成器首先沿着粗略的时间安排将先验样本向后移动：𝒙₁ → 𝒙^s → 𝒙^r → 𝒙^0 {\bm{x}}_{1}\to\hat{{\bm{x}}}_{s}\to\hat{{\bm{x}}}_{r}\to\hat{{\bm{x}}}_{0}，并缓存每个中间状态。

sents.en: A training state at time t t is then obtained by re-noising the nearest cached state that is cleaner than t t along the forward conditional path: 𝒙 ^ 0 \hat{{\bm{x}}}_{0} for t ∈ [ 0 , r ) t\in[0,r) , 𝒙 ^ r \hat{{\bm{x}}}_{r} for t ∈ [ r , s ) t\in[r,s) , and 𝒙 ^ s \hat{{\bm{x}}}_{s} for t ∈ [ s , 1 ] t\in[s,1] .
sents.zh: 随后，通过在沿前向条件路径上比时间 t 更干净的最近缓存状态重新添加噪声，可以获得时间 t 的训练状态：对于 t ∈ [0, r)，使用 𝒙^0 \hat{{\bm{x}}}_{0}；对于 t ∈ [r, s)，使用 𝒙^r \hat{{\bm{x}}}_{r}；对于 t ∈ [s, 1]，使用 𝒙^s \hat{{\bm{x}}}_{s}。

sents.en: Each re-noising step therefore covers a short interval, so the training states stay close to the 4-step trajectory used at inference.
sents.zh: 因此，每次重新添加噪声的步骤都覆盖一个短区间，使得训练状态保持接近推理时使用的 4 步轨迹。

sents.en: In this case, we observe more diversed background and better detailed being preserved from the teacher model.
sents.zh: 在这种情况下，我们观察到背景更加多样化，并且从教师模型中保留了更丰富的细节。

sents.en: With the same hardware and matching configuration, our CDMD requires approximately 7 GPU hours and 18 GB of peak memory (Tab. 7 ) .
sents.zh: 在相同的硬件和匹配配置下，我们的 CDMD 需要大约 7 GPU 小时和 18 GB 的峰值内存（表 7）。

sents.en: Its cost is higher than CD but lower than the reported costs of Diff-Instruct, DMD2, and MFD.
sents.zh: 其成本高于 CD，但低于 Diff-Instruct、DMD2 和 MFD 报告的成本。

sents.en: Note that our method performs significantly better than CD according to Table 3 .
sents.zh: 请注意，根据表 3，我们的方法在性能上显著优于 CD。

paragraphs.en: Fig. 13 compares how three transformer designs receive time information. (a) The DiT teacher predicts the instantaneous velocity and conditions every block on the embeddings of t t and the class label y y through adaLN-Zero. (b) The MeanFlow transformer predicts the average velocity and adds an embedding of the second time variable to the same signal, so every block sees both time variables. (c) The CDMD transformer keeps the teacher conditioning for the all blocks and adds the endpoint embedding, implemented as the gap t − r t-r , only to the last L − D L-D blocks and the final layer.
paragraphs.zh: 图 13 比较了三种 Transformer 设计接收时间信息的方式。 (a) DiT 教师模型通过 adaLN-Zero 预测瞬时速度，并通过 t t 和类别标签 y y 的嵌入对每个块进行条件约束。 (b) MeanFlow Transformer 预测平均速度，并将第二个时间变量的嵌入添加到同一信号中，因此每个块都能同时看到两个时间变量。 (c) CDMD Transformer 对所有块保留教师模型的条件约束，并且仅将端点嵌入（实现为间隔 t − r t-r）添加到最后 L − D L-D 个块和最后一层中。

paragraphs.en: We interpret this effect through teacher capacity. The first D D blocks receive exactly the conditioning of the teacher, so they can reproduce the teacher features for the instantaneous velocity at ( 𝒙 t , t ) ({\bm{x}}_{t},t) , which every interval [ r , t ] [r,t] shares. The endpoint signal then only modulates the later blocks, which turn these shared features into the average velocity of a specific interval. With D = 0 D=0 , every block must handle both time variables from the start, and the student spends capacity on the endpoint before it reproduces the teacher. This matches our finding on the t t and r r schedule in Appendix F.2 : the conditioning depth and the fraction of t = r t=r pairs both control how much of the student stays dedicated to the teacher velocity, and preserving this teacher capacity is what keeps the distilled student close to the teacher.
paragraphs.zh: 我们通过教师能力来解释这种效应。 前 D 个 D 块完全接收来自教师的条件信息，因此能够复现 ( 𝒙 t , t ) ({\bm{x}}_{t},t) 处的瞬时速度特征，而每个区间 [ r , t ] [r,t] 都共享这些特征。 随后，端点信号仅对后续块进行调制，这些块将共享的特征转化为特定区间的平均速度。 当 D = 0 D=0 时，每个块都必须从一开始就处理两个时间变量，并且学生在复现教师特征之前，会先消耗能力来处理端点。 这与我们在附录 F.2 中关于 t t 和 r r 调度的发现一致：条件深度和 t = r t=r 对的比例共同决定了学生模型在多大程度上专注于教师速度，而保留这种教师能力正是使蒸馏后的学生模型接近教师模型的关键。

paragraphs.en: We further study inference-time scaling by comparing Euler, Heun, and DDIM samplers under different classifier-free guidance scales. Figure 11 reports FID as a function of the number of sampling steps for w = 1.5 w=1.5 and w = 2.0 w=2.0 . In some literatures ( Lee et al., 2026 ; Song et al., 2023 ) , DDIM method has also been referred as the Restart sampler.
paragraphs.zh: 我们通过比较不同无分类器引导尺度下 Euler、Heun 和 DDIM 采样器，进一步研究了推理时的扩展性。 图 11 报告了当 w = 1.5 w=1.5 和 w = 2.0 w=2.0 时，FID 值与采样步数之间的关系。 在一些文献中（Lee et al., 2026；Song et al., 2023），DDIM 方法也被称作“重启采样器”。

sents.en: We further study inference-time scaling by comparing Euler, Heun, and DDIM samplers under different classifier-free guidance scales.
sents.zh: 我们通过比较不同无分类器引导尺度下 Euler、Heun 和 DDIM 采样器，进一步研究了推理时的扩展性。

sents.en: Figure 11 reports FID as a function of the number of sampling steps for w = 1.5 w=1.5 and w = 2.0 w=2.0 .
sents.zh: 图 11 报告了当 w = 1.5 w=1.5 和 w = 2.0 w=2.0 时，FID 值与采样步数之间的关系。

sents.en: In some literatures ( Lee et al., 2026 ; Song et al., 2023 ) , DDIM method has also been referred as the Restart sampler.
sents.zh: 在一些文献中（Lee et al., 2026；Song et al., 2023），DDIM 方法也被称作“重启采样器”。

paragraphs.en: The ablation suggests that increasing the inference-time sampling budget does not automatically improve our distilled model. DDIM gives the strongest low-step performance in both guidance settings and remains especially stable from one to four steps. Euler is competitive at one or two steps for w = 1.5 w=1.5 , but its FID increases as more steps are used and then plateaus. Heun is the least stable in the low-step regime: it exhibits a sharp FID spike at two steps and only recovers after additional steps. The effect is more pronounced under stronger guidance, where both Euler and Heun drift to noticeably worse FID than DDIM as the sampling budget grows.
paragraphs.zh: 消融实验表明，增加推理时的采样预算并不会自动提升我们蒸馏后的模型性能。 在两种引导设置中，DDIM 在低步数场景下表现最强，并且在第 1 到第 4 步之间始终保持特别稳定。 当 w = 1.5 时，Euler 在第 1 或第 2 步具有竞争力，但随着步数增加，其 FID 值会上升，随后趋于平稳。 Heun 在低步数阶段稳定性最差：它在第 2 步时出现明显的 FID 尖峰，直到增加更多步数后才恢复稳定。 在更强的引导条件下，这种效应更为显著：随着采样预算的增加，Euler 和 Heun 的 FID 值都会明显劣于 DDIM。

sents.zh: 消融实验表明，增加推理时的采样预算并不会自动提升我们蒸馏后的模型性能。

sents.en: DDIM gives the strongest low-step performance in both guidance settings and remains especially stable from one to four steps.
sents.zh: 在两种引导设置中，DDIM 在低步数场景下表现最强，并且在第 1 到第 4 步之间始终保持特别稳定。

sents.zh: 当 w = 1.5 时，Euler 在第 1 或第 2 步具有竞争力，但随着步数增加，其 FID 值会上升，随后趋于平稳。

sents.en: Heun is the least stable in the low-step regime: it exhibits a sharp FID spike at two steps and only recovers after additional steps.
sents.zh: Heun 在低步数阶段稳定性最差：它在第 2 步时出现明显的 FID 尖峰，直到增加更多步数后才恢复稳定。

sents.en: The effect is more pronounced under stronger guidance, where both Euler and Heun drift to noticeably worse FID than DDIM as the sampling budget grows.
sents.zh: 在更强的引导条件下，这种效应更为显著：随着采样预算的增加，Euler 和 Heun 的 FID 值都会明显劣于 DDIM。

paragraphs.en: These results give useful guidance for scaling inference time in our model. The interval-conditioned parameterization supports multi-step sampling, but the benefit depends strongly on the sampler and guidance scale. In this setting, DDIM is the most reliable choice for converting extra inference steps into stable sample quality, while higher-order or updates can amplify student-teacher mismatch at small step counts. We attribute this behavior primarily to these two factors. First, our training schedule assigns substantial probability mass to intervals with t ≠ r t\neq r , which may make the learned update less compatible with aggressive higher-order extrapolation at inference time. Second, the quality of the teacher, particularly its performance without CFG, has a pronounced effect on the distilled model. Empirically, we observe that differences in teacher performance without CFG translate into differences in the final student performance. Note that this student is trained with t = r t=r for only 10% of the pairs (Tab. 5 ). Appendix F.2 tests the first factor with a student trained with t = r t=r for 50% of the pairs.
paragraphs.zh: 这些结果为我们模型推理时间的扩展提供了有用的指导。 基于时间间隔的参数化支持多步采样，但其效果在很大程度上取决于采样器和引导尺度。 在此设置中，DDIM 是将额外推理步骤转化为稳定样本质量最可靠的选择，而高阶方法或更新则可能在步数较小时放大学生模型与教师模型之间的不匹配。 我们将这种行为主要归因于这两个因素。 首先，我们的训练计划将大量概率质量分配给了 t ≠ r 的时间间隔，这可能导致所学到的更新在推理时难以与激进的高阶外推兼容。 其次，教师模型的质量，尤其是其在无 CFG 条件下的表现，对蒸馏模型有显著影响。 从经验上看，我们观察到教师模型在无 CFG 条件下的性能差异会转化为最终学生模型性能的差异。 请注意，该学生模型仅在 10% 的数据对中采用 t = r 进行训练（表 5）。 附录 F.2 通过一个在 50% 数据对中采用 t = r 训练的学生模型检验了第一个因素。

paragraphs.en: Fig. 12 repeats the inference-time scaling study for the student distilled from LightningDiT-XL/2. We sample the same student with Euler and DDIM from 1 to 64 steps without retraining. Unlike the SiT-XL/2+VA-REPA student in Fig. 11 , the Euler FID decreases from 2.04 at 1 step to 1.62 at 2 steps and 1.37 at 4 steps (Tab. 1 ), and reaches its minimum at 8 steps. From 8 to 64 steps, the Euler FID stays nearly flat and close to the teacher reference instead of drifting upward. The Euler IS rises from about 294 at 1 step to about 320 at 16 steps and then saturates. Additional steps thus refine the samples, as they do for the teacher FM model, and never cause the large degradation of the 10% t = r t=r student.
paragraphs.zh: 图 12 重复了针对从 LightningDiT-XL/2 蒸馏出的学生模型在推理时的扩展性研究。 我们在不重新训练的情况下，使用欧拉法和 DDIM 对同一个学生模型进行采样，步数从 1 到 64。 与图 11 中的 SiT-XL/2+VA-REPA 学生模型不同，欧拉法的 FID 值从 1 步时的 2.04 降至 2 步时的 1.62、4 步时的 1.37（表 1），并在 8 步时达到最小值。 从 8 步到 64 步，欧拉法的 FID 值几乎保持平稳，并接近教师参考模型，而非持续上升。 欧拉法的 IS 值从 1 步时的约 294 上升到 16 步时的约 320，之后趋于饱和。 因此，增加步数会进一步优化采样结果，就像对教师 FM 模型那样，且绝不会导致 10% t = r t=r 学生模型出现显著退化。

paragraphs.en: The main difference between the two students is the training schedule. The LightningDiT student samples t = r t=r for 50% of the pairs, whereas the SiT-XL/2+VA-REPA student in Fig. 11 uses 10% (Tab. 5 ). On t = r t=r pairs, the objective reduces to ‖ 𝒖 𝜽 ​ ( 𝒙 ^ t , t , t ) − 𝒗 ⁡ ( 𝒙 ^ t , t ) ‖ 2 \norm{\vu_\vtheta(\hat{\vx}_t,t,t)-\vv(\hat{\vx}_t,t)}^{2} , so the student directly learns the teacher instantaneous velocity, which governs small sampling steps. This result matches Fig. 6(b) in the main text, where raising the fraction of t = r t=r pairs from 10% to 50% substantially reduces the multi-step degradation (FID about 5.1 instead of 9.8 at 50 steps). Since the same behavior appears with a different teacher, the stability is a property of the t t and r r schedule rather than of a particular teacher: keeping t = r t=r for 50% of the pairs is enough to preserve the multi-step behavior of the teacher as the number of sampling steps increases, while still giving the best 1-NFE FID in Tab. 1 .

paragraphs.en: DDIM behaves differently. Its FID is close to Euler at 1 and 2 steps but rises steadily after 4 steps and exceeds 5 at 64 steps, while its IS grows monotonically to above 420. Rising IS together with rising FID indicates that DDIM increasingly trades sample diversity for class fidelity as the number of steps grows. For this student, Euler is therefore the preferred sampler for inference-time scaling.
paragraphs.zh: DDIM 的行为有所不同。 在 1 步和 2 步时，其 FID 值接近 Euler，但在 4 步之后持续上升，并在 64 步时超过 5，而 IS 则单调增长至高于 420。 IS 和 FID 的同时上升表明，随着步数的增加，DDIM 越来越倾向于以样本多样性换取类别保真度。 因此，对于这位学生而言，Euler 是推理阶段扩展的首选采样器。

paragraphs.en: Classifier-free guidance (CFG) ( Ho and Salimans, 2022 ) is significant to class-conditional image generation because it facilitates conditional generation by extrapolating from unconditional to conditional predictions. Since the most pre-trained diffusion baselines are evaluated with CFG, we formulate our distillation objective to match the guided teacher dynamics rather than the unguided velocity field alone. Let 𝒗 ⁡ ( 𝒙 t , t ∣ 𝒄 ) {\bm{v}}({\bm{x}}_{t},t\mid{\bm{c}}) and 𝒗 ⁡ ( 𝒙 t , t ∣ ∅ ) {\bm{v}}({\bm{x}}_{t},t\mid\varnothing) denote the conditional and unconditional teacher velocity fields, respectively. For a guidance scale w ≥ 1 w\geq 1 , the guided velocity field is defined as 𝒗 cfg ​ ( 𝒙 t , t ∣ 𝒄 ) = ( 1 − w ) ​ 𝒗 ​ ( 𝒙 t , t ∣ ∅ ) + w ​ 𝒗 ​ ( 𝒙 t , t ∣ 𝒄 ) . {\bm{v}}^{\text{cfg}}({\bm{x}}_{t},t\mid{\bm{c}})=(1-w)\,{\bm{v}}({\bm{x}}_{t},t\mid\varnothing)+w\,{\bm{v}}({\bm{x}}_{t},t\mid{\bm{c}}).

paragraphs.en: A key limitation of the current formulation is the absence of meaningful constraints on the total derivative term d d t ⁡ 𝒖 ⁡ ( 𝒙 t , t , r ) = 𝒗 ⁡ ( 𝒙 t , t ) ​ D 𝒙 t ​ 𝒖 + ∂ t 𝒖 \derivative{t}{\bm{u}}({\bm{x}}_{t},t,r)={\bm{v}}({\bm{x}}_{t},t)D_{{\bm{x}}_{t}}{\bm{u}}+\partial_{t}{\bm{u}} . To date, this component has not been rigorously analyzed. In prior work, it is typically detached from the computational graph and excluded from backpropagation, effectively treating it as a constant. However, empirical observations reveal that its norm is large and fluctuates substantially throughout training, suggesting that this simplification may be problematic. A plausible direction for regularization is to leverage a well-trained reference velocity field 𝒗 ⁡ ( 𝒙 t , t ) {\bm{v}}({\bm{x}}_{t},t) , encouraging the derivative term to exhibit similar, more stable behavior. In practice, not only is the dataset private, but the teacher model weights are also inaccessible. Hence, we cannot initialize the student model with the teacher model weights, which is a common practice in distillation work. This makes training more challenging and less stable. Moreover, we speculate that for different tasks, the way we bootstrapped our x t x_{t} is of great importance. This can substantially influence the learning dynamics and overall effectiveness of distillation.
paragraphs.zh: 当前公式的一个关键局限性在于，对全导数项 d d t ⁡ 𝒖 ⁡ ( 𝒙 t , t , r ) = 𝒗 ⁡ ( 𝒙 t , t ) ​ D 𝒙 t ​ 𝒖 + ∂ t 𝒖 \derivative{t}{\bm{u}}({\bm{x}}_{t},t,r)={\bm{v}}({\bm{x}}_{t},t)D_{{\bm{x}}_{t}}{\bm{u}}+\partial_{t}{\bm{u}} 缺乏有意义的约束。 迄今为止，这一部分尚未得到严格分析。 在以往的研究中，该部分通常被从计算图中分离出来，并排除在反向传播之外，实际上将其视为一个常数。 然而，经验观察表明，其范数很大，并且在整个训练过程中波动显著，这意味着这种简化可能存在问题的。 一种合理的正则化方向是利用训练良好的参考速度场 𝒗 ⁡ ( 𝒙 t , t ) {\bm{v}}({\bm{x}}_{t},t) ，促使导数项表现出类似且更稳定的行为。 在实践中，不仅数据集是私有的，而且教师模型的权重也无法获取。 因此，我们无法像蒸馏研究中的常见做法那样，使用教师模型的权重来初始化学生模型。 这使得训练更具挑战性且稳定性较差。 此外，我们推测对于不同的任务，我们启动 x t x_{t} 的方式可能至关重要。 这可能会显著影响学习的动态过程以及蒸馏的整体效果。

sents.en: A key limitation of the current formulation is the absence of meaningful constraints on the total derivative term d d t ⁡ 𝒖 ⁡ ( 𝒙 t , t , r ) = 𝒗 ⁡ ( 𝒙 t , t ) ​ D 𝒙 t ​ 𝒖 + ∂ t 𝒖 \derivative{t}{\bm{u}}({\bm{x}}_{t},t,r)={\bm{v}}({\bm{x}}_{t},t)D_{{\bm{x}}_{t}}{\bm{u}}+\partial_{t}{\bm{u}} .
sents.zh: 当前公式的一个关键局限性在于，对全导数项 d d t ⁡ 𝒖 ⁡ ( 𝒙 t , t , r ) = 𝒗 ⁡ ( 𝒙 t , t ) ​ D 𝒙 t ​ 𝒖 + ∂ t 𝒖 \derivative{t}{\bm{u}}({\bm{x}}_{t},t,r)={\bm{v}}({\bm{x}}_{t},t)D_{{\bm{x}}_{t}}{\bm{u}}+\partial_{t}{\bm{u}} 缺乏有意义的约束。

sents.en: To date, this component has not been rigorously analyzed.
sents.zh: 迄今为止，这一部分尚未得到严格分析。

sents.en: In prior work, it is typically detached from the computational graph and excluded from backpropagation, effectively treating it as a constant.
sents.zh: 在以往的研究中，该部分通常被从计算图中分离出来，并排除在反向传播之外，实际上将其视为一个常数。

sents.en: However, empirical observations reveal that its norm is large and fluctuates substantially throughout training, suggesting that this simplification may be problematic.
sents.zh: 然而，经验观察表明，其范数很大，并且在整个训练过程中波动显著，这意味着这种简化可能存在问题的。

sents.en: A plausible direction for regularization is to leverage a well-trained reference velocity field 𝒗 ⁡ ( 𝒙 t , t ) {\bm{v}}({\bm{x}}_{t},t) , encouraging the derivative term to exhibit similar, more stable behavior.
sents.zh: 一种合理的正则化方向是利用训练良好的参考速度场 𝒗 ⁡ ( 𝒙 t , t ) {\bm{v}}({\bm{x}}_{t},t) ，促使导数项表现出类似且更稳定的行为。

sents.en: In practice, not only is the dataset private, but the teacher model weights are also inaccessible.
sents.zh: 在实践中，不仅数据集是私有的，而且教师模型的权重也无法获取。

sents.en: Hence, we cannot initialize the student model with the teacher model weights, which is a common practice in distillation work.
sents.zh: 因此，我们无法像蒸馏研究中的常见做法那样，使用教师模型的权重来初始化学生模型。

sents.en: This makes training more challenging and less stable.
sents.zh: 这使得训练更具挑战性且稳定性较差。

sents.en: Moreover, we speculate that for different tasks, the way we bootstrapped our x t x_{t} is of great importance.
sents.zh: 此外，我们推测对于不同的任务，我们启动 x t x_{t} 的方式可能至关重要。

sents.en: This can substantially influence the learning dynamics and overall effectiveness of distillation.
sents.zh: 这可能会显著影响学习的动态过程以及蒸馏的整体效果。
